name: C05 timer start events
description: A timer start job is created at deployment; the scenario fires the job of one start event (start.timer) and follows the new instance.

scenarios.name: the date start fires and creates an instance
the cycle start (R3/PT1H with a future end date) fires and creates an instance
the cron start (daily at noon, calendar cycle) fires and creates an instance
a repeat whose end date has passed is dropped when its job fires: no instance
scenarios.description: DefaultJobManager.executeTimerJob deletes a timer job whose due date is after activiti:endDate without running it (engine finding 26).

expectFailure.messageContains: created no process instance of process 'timerStarts'
